name: kodo_architect
notes: SubAgentSpec for `architect` (stage 2 author, paired with architect_critic).

input_schema.input_paths: Must include the accepted Narrative and Tech Stack documents.

components.description: The Responsibility Map as data: one entry per component you named, with the codenames it depends on. You already decide this to write Part 1 — declaring it here is what lets later stages be handed the designs of a component's neighbours automatically, instead of re-deriving your decomposition from prose. Required unless you are escalating (see `reason`).

code.description: The component's stable codename, e.g. LEADERBOARD.

depends_on.description: Codenames this component consumes. [] for one that consumes nothing.

end_to_end_testable.description: The Architect's end-to-end testability determination (Part 3 of the architecture document). The Guide reads the stage-8 gate from this value. Required unless you are escalating (see `reason`).
